instruction: Update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc in the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment using its CLI/API tools, and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. On this machine, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is an L-shaped micro-studio apartment with a living area, bathroom, kitchenette, roof slab, and a small set of exterior openings. The housing team wants the unit packaged as a clear studio record for leasing coordination. Keep the L-shaped envelope, room arrangement, door/window fills, and two slabs unchanged, but make the storey name and room metadata read like a completed studio unit. Use a timber-stud-and-gypsum internal wall language consistent with a lightweight apartment fit-out, group the three rooms as the studio unit, and mark the coordinated items with revision code BONSAI-CLI-03.
